subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already collects many of the underlying facts, but the public wording, ordering, and optional JSON diagnosis block are product/UX choices with operator-impact tradeoffs.

options.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.

options.title: Keep independent panels
options.body: Leave current doctor output as separate panels and only improve individual messages when a specific transcript is live-reproduced.

options.title: Define structured output first
options.body: Design a compact diagnosis object before changing prose, then render the final doctor panel from that object later.

recommendation.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, reusing existing service/runtime/RPC/channel facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated work on doctor orchestration and gateway service recovery paths.
